decisions.reason: As a charting add-on tightly linked to the firm's core web-mapping stack, several years of survival would suggest results are at least near aspiration and the resource burden is low enough to keep it.

This hierarchical search plugin is somewhat niche and therefore more exposed if results fall below aspiration, but its close fit with the existing offer and likely modest maintenance cost support retaining it for now.

The GIS platform is a flagship product line central to the firm's direction, so behavioral-theory logic implies management would continue it unless performance were clearly and persistently below aspiration.

The search extension is a natural complement to the firm's web map applications and can draw on shared customers and resources, so it is kept despite some risk of later rationalization or integration into newer development.
